steps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context
2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And User A has entity FMO PORTAL ADMIN with owner role TEST_OWNER
4. And the Category editor shows fixture record 101 in the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
5. And the Category update POST returns HTTP 403 with message="Access denied"
6. When User A clicks the button labelled "Update" inside the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
7. Then the alert in the portal notification area displays exactly "Access denied"
8. And the POST to "/api/auth/v1/fmo/admin/category/update" has HTTP status 403 and no category record in its response
9. And the visible Category record 101 values equal their pre-update values
10. And the installed access credential equals its pre-action value
11. And the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible
